newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: VERONICA RAISES SHARE OF DUTCH TV AUDIENCE IN NOV.
newsitem.headline: VERONICA RAISES SHARE OF DUTCH TV AUDIENCE IN NOV.

text.p: Veronica, which
left the Dutch public broadcasting system in 1995 to become a
commercial broadcaster, raised its share of the Dutch television
audience to 10 percent in November from eight in October.
The NOS audience research unit published the following Dutch
television viewing figures for November:
Channel Audience share in pct: Nov 96 Oct 96 Nov 95
Veronica 10 8 9
SBS6 7 7 4
RTL5 4 5 6
Sport7 3 3 0
Arcade 2 2 1
Other channels 15 15 15
NOTES - NL1, NL2 and NL3 are public channels. RTL4, RTL5,
Veronica, SBS and Sport7 are commercial channels. Arcade figures
are combined total for its TV10 and Music Factory channels.
OWNERSHIP DETAILS:
RTL4 and RTL5 -- Dutch publisher VNU owns 38 pct
of both channels, Luxembourg-based CLT owns 61 pct of both.
SBS6 -- Scandinavian Broadcasting System owns 70 pct of
SBS6, Dutch publisher De Telegraaf 30 percent.
TV10 and Music Factory -- Both channels are wholly owned
units of Dutch media group Wegener Arcade .
Sport7 -- PTT Nederland , ING , Philips
Electronics and Dutch TV production firm Endemol each
own 19.5 percent stakes in Sport7. Dutch soccer association KNVB
has a 10 percent stake and De Telegraaf five percent.
Veronica -- Left the public broadcasting system in 1995 to
become a commercial station.
